name: Busy
when: Customer unavailable or cannot speak right now.

name: No Answer
when: Rings out — no answer, no voicemail reached.

name: Callback — Agent
when: Rapport built — customer expects you specifically to call back. Use manual dial if reconnecting immediately.

name: Callback — Queue
when: Callback requested before any rapport is built. Routes to first available agent.

name: Disconnected Number
when: Number inactive or no longer in service.

name: Bad Data
when: Wrong name, incomplete, or unusable lead info.

name: DNC
when: Customer explicitly asks not to be contacted again. Use only when they say it directly.

name: Not Interested
when: Customer declines but does not request removal.

name: Does Not Qualify
when: Customer does not meet eligibility criteria.

name: Email Requested
when: Customer wants an info pack only.

name: Email & Callback
when: Customer wants an info pack and a callback.

name: Lead Submitted
when: The only code to use when a completed lead has been submitted to {{clientShort}}.

name: Withheld Information
when: Customer completed the call but refused one or more non-negotiable fields.
